scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && node scripts/check-runtime-entry.mjs && npm run sidecar:build && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:ci: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --offline
scripts.bundle:app: npm run sidecar:build && npm run sidecar:smoke && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.bundle:dmg: npm run sidecar:build && npm run sidecar:smoke && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.bundle:preview: npm run sidecar:build && npm run sidecar:smoke && tauri build --bundles dmg && tauri build --bundles app && npm run smoke:bundle && npm run release:verify -- --mode preview
